{{Quote|You two may not be as good as Boba Fett, but you've done well enough so far.|8t88, to the Tusken and Gran hirelings|audio=File:8t88NotAsGoodAsFett.flac|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
A '''Tusken Raider bounty hunter''' lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. A member of the [[Grave Tuskens]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary group]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was hired by the [[Model 88-series administration droid|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to serve as backup and as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] as 8t88 held a meeting with former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]]. At 8t88's command, the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] held Katarn at gunpoint during the rebel's meeting with 8t88. When the droid departed, the Tusken and a [[Unidentified Gran (Rimmer's Rest)|Gran bounty hunter]] prepared to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Katarn. However, their prey unconsciously called upon [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to defeat the two bounty hunters. Katarn left them dazed in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] as he went to pursue 8t88.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Tell me what it is, and these gentlemen won't have to indulge their darker side."<br />"The Dark Side? I've been there. Do your worst.|8t88 threatens to set his hirelings on Katarn|<ref name="DF2" />}}
[[File:Katarn_in_Trouble.png|thumb|left|250px|The bounty hunter holds Katarn at gunpoint]]
A [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was one of many Tuskens to leave their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and become a member of the [[Grave Tuskens]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary group]] that eventually found service under the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]], an enforcer of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="BT" /> Led by [[Rogg]], many of the Grave Tuskens pursued Imperial endeavors on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]<ref name="RA" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' during the [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> However, the Tusken Raider opted to take his own path and became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="DF2" /><ref name="RA" />

During 5 ABY,<ref name="TNEC" /> the Tusken<ref name="DF2" /> was hired by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] to serve as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] during a meeting with ex-mercenary and former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Kyle Katarn]] on the moon [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. 8t88 also hired a [[Unidentified Gran (Rimmer's Rest)|Gran bounty hunter]] for the Tusken to work with.<ref name="RA" /> As it happened, the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] shared a history with Katarn.<ref name="RAAD">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref> Regardless, the meeting was set to take place at the [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. 8t88 arrived first and conversed with Katarn, who had sought 8t88 to divulge information surrounding the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Morgan Katarn|his father]]. Although late to the confrontation,<ref name="RA" /> the Tusken and Gran arrived as 8t88 told Katarn what he knew: a warlord named [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] had killed Katarn's father. At this moment, the Tusken slid behind Katarn and held a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] to the rebel's head<ref name="DF2" /> as the Tusken confiscated Katarn's [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistol]].<ref name="RAAD" /> 8t88 revealed that he was actually working for Jerec, but promised Katarn his life if the rebel agreed to now give 8t88 information concerning a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]]. Katarn refused, and 8t88 left the cantina, leaving his hirelings to kill Katarn.<ref name="DF2" />

Before they could, the Gran tried to taunt Katarn,<ref name="RAAD" /> giving the latter enough time to grab the Tusken's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] and slam him onto the bar table, which disarmed both bounty hunters. As they gathered their bearings, Katarn unconsciously called upon [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and grabbed his earlier confiscated [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and held it on the bounty hunters.<ref name="RA" /> The pair was immobilized by Katarn's sudden trick, and the agent left them dumbfounded as he went on to pursue 8t88.<ref name="RAAD" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Good luck trying to find him. This city is one huge maze.|The Tusken Raider casts doubts on Katarn's abilities|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
The Tusken Raider had [[Color/Legends|gray]]-colored skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="DF2" /> Like all Grave Tuskens, the Tusken had removed the covering that otherwise concealed his face, allowing [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large to see him.<ref name="BT" /> After Katarn used the Force to grab his [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistol]], the Tusken was surprised by the sight, and pointed out to the Gran how the blaster was moving without anyone touching it. According to 8t88, the Tusken was not as skillful as the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett]]. When Katarn voiced his plan to track 8t88 down, the Tusken doubted Katarn's ability to do so, as Nar Shaddaa was a maze-like locale. However, Katarn had placed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking device]] on 8t88's leg.<ref name="RAAD" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Hand over the blaster. Now.|The Tusken demands Katarn's blaster|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
During the confrontation with Katarn, the Tusken wore brown gloves, a blue chest plate, and grayish-white wraps around his arms parts of his head. He wore a device over his mouth, and carried a DH-17 blaster pistol.<ref name="DF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bounty hunter first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. The bounty hunter appeared in the game's second cutscene, where only the arm of an actor was visible. When gameplay started right after the cutscene, the bounty hunter was shown to be a Grave Tusken.<ref name="DF2" /> However, in the novella adaption written by [[William C. Dietz]], ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', the bounty hunter was described as being a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]].<ref name="RA" /> In addition, while in the novella and game the bounty hunter is knocked unconscious during the encounter,<ref name="DF2" /><ref name="RA" /> he is only disarmed during the audio drama and is never rendered completely unconscious. A final difference between versions is that in the game, Katarn steals the bounty hunter's weapon and aims it at the Gran bounty hunter, whereas in the other two sources he uses his own Bryar pistol. This article treats the events from the novella as the correct depiction of events, but treats the individual's species as a Tusken Raider as seen in the game, since the game is the only source to have physically depicted the character.

The actor who portrayed the Tusken character in ''Dark Forces II''{{'s}} live-action cutscenes was uncredited. In the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio adaption of ''Rebel Agent'']], the bounty hunter and his partner are identified by 8t88 as "goons." Credited as Goon 2, as he was the second of the two characters to speak, the character's voice was provided by [[Bill Slichter]].
